topic: Trucks - runaway truck ramp (gravel arrester bed)
question: WHY DID HE STEER
INTO THE GRAVEL?
options: To cool down the hot tires
To let traffic behind him pass
To get around a crash ahead
answer_full: His brakes gave out. That gravel lane is a runaway truck ramp
recap: A loaded semi truck, smoke pouring from its wheels, swerves off a mountain highway into a lane full of deep, loose gravel.
explain: On a long, steep downhill, a heavy truck's brakes have to soak up a huge amount of energy. They can get so hot that they barely work anymore.
That's why mountain passes have runaway truck ramps: an escape lane filled with deep, loose, rounded gravel.
The wheels sink in and the gravel drags the truck to a stop. A tow truck pulls it out later, which is a lot better than a crash at the bottom of the hill.
